buyer: Owner or dispatch manager at a 3-15 truck HVAC company

steps.name: Capture the service request
steps.trigger: Approved web form or dispatcher entry
steps.action: Normalize contact, address, system type, urgency, and access window
steps.gate: Human confirms emergency priority and service area

steps.name: Prepare the estimate
steps.action: Apply the selected estimate template and flag missing site details
steps.output: Draft estimate ready for owner approval
steps.gate: Owner approves scope, price, and exclusions before send

steps.name: Reserve the crew window
steps.action: Create a calendar hold and dispatch brief
steps.output: Confirmed job window with assigned owner
steps.gate: Dispatcher resolves conflicts and travel time

steps.name: Issue the invoice draft
steps.action: Build invoice payload from accepted estimate and change notes
steps.gate: Office approves final total; live Stripe remains disabled

steps.name: Close the loop
steps.action: Queue receipt, unpaid reminder, warranty note, or review request
steps.output: Typed follow-up task with due date
steps.gate: No customer message sends from this starter
